title: The A.I. Researcher Whose Rebellion Is Changing Everything

sentences.en: 33 presidents.

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛里最棒的团队。

I use a different starting word every day.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，即可在 nytimes.com 网页斜杠 subscribe 获取特别优惠。

sentences.en: Can you just read the third post from your thread?
sentences.zh: 你能读一下你那条讨论串里的第三个帖子吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.
sentences.zh: 构建人工智能的人真诚地相信，它可能在本十年结束前消灭我们所有人。

sentences.en: This is not a marketing stunt.
sentences.zh: 这不是营销噱头。

sentences.en: If anything, many executives and senior researchers will couch their phrasing in the press to sound sensible, but I hear the same people express fear privately.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，那就是许多高管和高级研究人员在媒体前会措辞谨慎，听起来很理智，但我听到同样的人在私下里表达恐惧。

sentences.en: No other human activity poses this level of danger.
sentences.zh: 没有任何其他人类活动会带来这种程度的危险。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrow-F.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是娜塔莉·基特罗-F。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A dire warning about AI and humanity from a former anthropic researcher who suddenly resigned.
sentences.zh: 一名突然辞职的前Anthropic研究员对人工智能与人类发出的可怕警告。

sentences.en: Over the last week, a young AI researcher quit anthropic and posted warnings about the risks of artificial intelligence that went viral.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，一位年轻的人工智能研究员退出了Anthropic，并发布了关于人工智能风险的警告，这些警告在网上病毒式传播。

sentences.en: I want to better understand what you mean when you say AI could kill us all.
sentences.zh: 我想更好地理解你说人工智能可能会消灭我们所有人是什么意思。

sentences.en: I mean, how likely is this doomsday scenario that you've presented?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你提出的这个世界末日场景发生的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: And he's not the only one to sound the alarm.
sentences.zh: 而且他不是唯一一个敲响警钟的人。

sentences.en: And kicked off a crisis that culminated this weekend in a call to action by the most prominent leaders in the industry.
sentences.zh: 并引发了一场危机，这场危机在这个周末达到了高潮，行业中最杰出的领袖们发出了行动呼吁。

sentences.en: We begin with the stunning news from Anthropics CEO Dario Amadei, that he is urging a slowdown when it comes to the development of artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我们首先报道Anthropic首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代伊发布的震撼消息，他敦促在人工智能发展方面放慢脚步。

sentences.en: It was a pronouncement that his chief competitor, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk quickly agreed with.
sentences.zh: 他的主要竞争对手、OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·阿尔特曼和埃隆·马斯克迅速同意了这一声明。

sentences.en: Those leaders came out in favor of a global slowdown in the development of artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 这些领导人公开支持在全球范围内放慢人工智能的发展。

sentences.en: It's funny, I agree with Jacob much more than I disagree with him.
sentences.zh: 真搞笑，我同意雅各布的地方远多于不同意他的地方。

sentences.en: Because when he left, he said, you know, I think anthropic is the most responsible player, right?
sentences.zh: 因为他离开时说，你知道，我认为Anthropic是最负责任的玩家，对吧？

sentences.en: He wasn't calling out us.
sentences.zh: 他不是在点我们名。

sentences.en: He was calling out the dynamic of the industry as a whole moving too faSt.
sentences.zh: 他是在指出整个行业发展过快的整体动态。

sentences.en: Today, we talked to the researcher who got us to this milestone moment, Jacob Coxon.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们采访了将我们带到这个里程碑时刻的研究员雅各布·考克森。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月14日，星期一。

sentences.en: Jacob, hi.
sentences.zh: 雅各布，你好。

sentences.en: What's up?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Can you hear us?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我们说话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can hear you fine.
sentences.zh: 可以，我能听得很清楚。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Thanks for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: By now, I think you've been on maybe every major news network saying essentially that
sentences.zh: 到现在为止，我想你大概上过所有主流新闻网络，基本上都在说

sentences.en: AI could pose an existential threat to humanity.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可能对人类构成生存威胁。

sentences.en: And we've seen industry leaders grappling with that, lawmakers as well.
sentences.zh: 我们看到行业领袖以及立法者都在努力应对这一问题。

sentences.en: Did you anticipate this kind of response?
sentences.zh: 你预料到会有这种反响吗？

sentences.en: No, I just wanted to tweet what I was thinking.
sentences.zh: 没有，我只是想发推特说出我的想法。

sentences.en: I expected it to maybe go a bit viral among people that already shared this belief, but I did not expect it to hit the whole world.
sentences.zh: 我原以为它可能在已经有这种信念的人群中稍微病毒式传播一下，但我没想到它会轰动全世界。

sentences.en: It's kind of surprising to me that it was my tweet that happened to trigger a particular wave of talking about this, because of course, the experts have been talking about this for
sentences.zh: 我有点惊讶，居然是我的推特恰好触发了一波关于这个话题的特定讨论，因为当然，专家们一直在讨论这个

sentences.en: like so long.
sentences.zh: 已经很久了。

sentences.en: Okay, well, we're going to get to the tweet, but I want to start this conversation by just asking you about your first experience with AI.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们等会儿会聊到那条推特，但我想先问问你关于你接触人工智能的最初经历来开始这次对话。

sentences.en: When was the first time that you heard about this technology?
sentences.zh: 你第一次听说这项技术是什么时候？

sentences.en: Do you remember?
sentences.zh: 你还记得吗？

sentences.en: I remember the first time I heard about it really working was AlphaGo in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我记得我第一次听说它真正起作用是在2016年的AlphaGo。

sentences.en: A Google supercomputer has beaten the world's best player at the 3,000-year-old Chinese board game called Go.
sentences.zh: 谷歌超级计算机击败了世界围棋顶级玩家，这是一种拥有3000年历史的中国棋盘游戏。

sentences.en: So that was when DeepMind's Go-playing AI beat Lee Sedol, the champion Go player, in a match.
sentences.zh: 所以那是DeepMind的下棋AI在一场比赛中击败围棋冠军李世石的时候。

sentences.en: The aim of the game is to capture as much territory as possible on a 19 by 19 square grid.
sentences.zh: 这个游戏的目标是在19乘19的方格网格上尽可能多地占领领土。

sentences.en: And that was pretty crazy.
sentences.zh: 这真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: There are more possible moves on the board than atoms in the universe.
sentences.zh: 棋盘上可能的走法比宇宙中的原子还要多。

sentences.en: I studied math in college, but I sought to go.
sentences.zh: 我在大学学的是数学，但我寻找围棋。

sentences.en: It was like exciting to hear that AI could win at that.
sentences.zh: 听到人工智能能在那个领域获胜，感觉很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And then GPT-3 released during the pandemic when I was graduating.
sentences.zh: 然后GPT-3在大流行期间我毕业时发布了。

sentences.en: Chat GPT, which is a new product from OpenAI.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT是OpenAI推出的一款新产品。

sentences.en: It's a remarkable beta service.
sentences.zh: 这是一项卓越的测试版服务。

sentences.en: It can interpret human language, answer questions.
sentences.zh: 它能解释人类语言，回答问题。

sentences.en: It can even generate written texts, essays, books, news articles, and even computer code.
sentences.zh: 它甚至能生成书面文本、论文、书籍、新闻文章，甚至计算机代码。

sentences.en: And it's really good.
sentences.zh: 而且它真的很棒。

sentences.en: By the early 2020, so by five years ago, it was pretty clear that this was going to be a pretty big deal.
sentences.zh: 到2020年初，也就是五年前，很明显这将是一件非常大条的事。

sentences.en: This was going to be more important than doing math or basically anything else.
sentences.zh: 这会比做数学或者基本上任何其他事情都更重要。

sentences.en: What was it about those models that made you feel that way, that made you sure of that?
sentences.zh: 是这些模型的什么特质让你有这种感觉，让你对此深信不疑？

sentences.en: Specifically, GPT-3 was the first model that was capable of these quite general behaviors.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，GPT-3是第一个能够表现出这些相当通用行为的模型。

sentences.en: It was this evidence that you could do this general training procedure, and then some new capabilities would pop out of it.
sentences.zh: 这证明了你可以进行这种通用的训练程序，然后就会从中涌现出一些新的能力。

sentences.en: By that point, I was pretty convinced the singularity would happen at some point, as were a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 到了那个时候，我相当确信奇点会在某个时刻发生，很多人也这么认为。

sentences.en: Can you define singularity in this context for people who may not be super familiar with what that actually means?
sentences.zh: 对于那些可能不太熟悉这个词真正含义的人，你能在这个语境下定义一下“奇点”吗？

sentences.en: I think one way of thinking about it is it's the point beyond which you can't see.
sentences.zh: 我想思考它的一种方式是，它是你无法看透的那个点。

sentences.en: It's like a sort of wall when you look into the future.
sentences.zh: 当你望向未来时，它就像一堵墙。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is everything gets faster.
sentences.zh: 原因在于一切都变得更快了。

sentences.en: So imagine you're training in AI, and it makes itself smarter so that what previously took six months now takes three months.
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下你正在训练一个AI，它让自己变得更聪明，以至于以前需要六个月的事情现在只需要三个月。

sentences.en: The singularity is just this increasing chaos as machines accelerate the process that's creating them.
sentences.zh: 奇点就是随着机器加速创造它们的进程而不断增加的混乱。

sentences.en: Until eventually, you can expect years' worth of research progress happening in days, and then years of research happening in hours.
sentences.zh: 直到最终，你可以预见几年的研究进展在几天内发生，然后几年的研究在几小时内发生。

sentences.en: And then you can't see past the big wall.
sentences.zh: 然后你就无法看清那堵巨墙之后的东西了。

sentences.en: And were you excited about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此感到兴奋吗？

sentences.en: Were you worried about it?
sentences.zh: 你为此担心吗？

sentences.en: Were you talking about it with your friends over beers?
sentences.zh: 你有没有和朋友喝着啤酒讨论过这个？

sentences.en: What was the vibe for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说当时的氛围是怎样的？

sentences.en: Yeah, people talk about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们会谈论它。

sentences.en: People think about it.
sentences.zh: 人们会思考它。

sentences.en: It also makes people crazy.
sentences.zh: 这也让人发疯。

sentences.en: So, I mean, like thinking about all of your labor becoming obsolete does turn people insane once they actually internalize it,
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，想想你所有的劳动力都将变得过时，一旦人们真正内化了这一点，确实会把人逼疯，

sentences.en: or from the perspective of other people makes them sound insane.
sentences.zh: 或者从其他人的角度来看，听起来像疯了。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Because it forces you to toss around ideas like, oh, this could cause extinction, or this could cause, you know, utopia.
sentences.zh: 因为它迫使你思考各种想法，比如，哦，这可能会导致灭绝，或者这可能会带来，你知道的，乌托邦。

sentences.en: And these ideas are often tossed around by people who are working on this technology.
sentences.zh: 而这些想法经常被从事这项技术的人所抛出。

sentences.en: I think at the time, yeah, I wouldn't say it made me crazy, but there was this nebulous possibility of a big thing that was like, it's kind of a mixture of upside and downside,
sentences.zh: 我想当时，是的，我不会说它让我发疯，但有一种关于一件大事的朦胧可能性，就像，它有点像积极面和消极面的混合体，

sentences.en: but you don't really differentiate between those when you're so far away from it.
sentences.zh: 但当你离它那么远时，你并没有真正去区分它们。

sentences.en: I mean, man, I knew a guy who like, he was convinced that he made people conscious by interacting with them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，天哪，我认识一个人，他确信自己通过与人互动赋予了他们意识。

sentences.en: He was so close to AI.
sentences.zh: 他离AI太近了。

sentences.en: He was like, I'm in a simulation.
sentences.zh: 他觉得：我在一个模拟程序里。

sentences.en: Other people, if they're not involved in AI, aren't conscious.
sentences.zh: 其他人如果不参与AI，就没有意识。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But if I interact with them, they become part of the AI thing.
sentences.zh: 但如果我和他们互动，他们就成了AI事物的一部分。

sentences.en: So they become conscious.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有了意识。

sentences.en: So he was like, when I shake hands with someone, I imbue them with consciousness.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，当我跟某人握手时，我赋予了他们意识。

sentences.en: It's just to give a flavor of like, what thinking about this stuff does to people.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了说明思考这些东西会对人产生什么影响。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay, so given all that, talk to me about how you decided to go work at OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 好的，鉴于这一切，跟我聊聊你是如何决定去OpenAI工作的。

sentences.en: What was that decision like?
sentences.zh: 那个决定是怎样的？

sentences.en: It was pretty spur of the moment.
sentences.zh: 那是挺一时的冲动。

sentences.en: It was not some like grand master plan.
sentences.zh: 并不是什么宏伟的总体计划。

sentences.en: The opportunity came up.
sentences.zh: 机会出现了。

sentences.en: They were doing really cool stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们在做真的很酷的事情。

sentences.en: The research is interesting.
sentences.zh: 研究很有趣。

sentences.en: I've been thinking about this for a while.
sentences.zh: 我考虑这个已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: So I decided to move to San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定搬到旧金山。

sentences.en: And what was it like?
sentences.zh: 那里的情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: So many of us obviously know of this company, but we have no idea what it's like to be inside it.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人显然都知道这家公司，但我们完全不知道身处其中是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it's basically like a fast moving research lab where there happens to be a lot of money flying around from investors.
sentences.zh: 所以它基本上就像是一个快速发展的研究实验室，碰巧有很多投资者的资金在周围飞来飞去。

sentences.en: Imagine like it's like an open floor office, a lot of whiteboards around, a lot of little meeting rooms, people kind of in huddles, brainstorming on whiteboards.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，它就像一个开放式办公区，周围有很多白板，有很多小会议室，人们三三两两地聚在一起，在白板上进行头脑风暴。

sentences.en: A lot of talk at lunchtime about the future of AI, also specific technical probleMs.
sentences.zh: 午餐时有很多关于AI未来的讨论，还有具体的技术问题。

sentences.en: Imagine like a university department, which happens to have like really nice free food.
sentences.zh: 想象一下大学里的一个系，碰巧有非常棒的免费食物。

sentences.en: And in layman's terms, what did you actually do?
sentences.zh: 用外行的话来说，你实际上做了什么？

sentences.en: I know you said research, but what did that mean actually?
sentences.zh: 我知道你说是研究，但那到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Like what were you working on?
sentences.zh: 比如你当时在做什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was exciting about it?
sentences.zh: 令人兴奋的点在哪里？

sentences.en: So data, which I know often freaks people out because they're like, oh, you mean like stealing all my work and training AI on like my family photos and stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以关于数据，我知道这经常把人吓坏，因为他们会想，哦，你是说像偷走我所有的工作，用我的家庭照片之类的数据来训练AI。

sentences.en: But other people stole the data or scraped the data.
sentences.zh: 但其他人偷了数据或者抓取了数据。

sentences.en: That wasn't you.
sentences.zh: 那不是你。

sentences.en: No, that wasn't me.
sentences.zh: 不，那不是我。

sentences.en: I was part of the research team that would take the data that we scraped and then decide which bits were good to train on.
sentences.zh: 我是研究团队的一员，负责拿我们抓取的数据，然后决定哪些部分适合用来训练。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Not all data is good.
sentences.zh: 并非所有数据都是好的。

sentences.en: So if someone writes like, if you write like garbage pros online, we don't want to put that in the AI.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人写了像，如果你在网上写垃圾散文，我们不想把它放进AI里。

sentences.en: We want to give it the good stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们想给它好东西。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But it's a little bit hard to automatically tell what the good stuff is versus the bad stuff.
sentences.zh: 但要自动区分好东西和坏东西有点难。

sentences.en: How did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: How did you figure that out?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么弄明白这一点的？

sentences.en: What's good data?
sentences.zh: 什么是好数据？

sentences.en: What's bad data?
sentences.zh: 什么是坏数据？

sentences.en: Broad strokes is you try and divide it into different types at quite a granular level.
sentences.zh: 大致的做法是，你尝试在相当细颗粒度的层面上把它分成不同的类型。

sentences.en: So say like this is essays written by motorcyclists or whatever, and this is like photos of monkeys.
sentences.zh: 比如这是摩托车手写的散文之类的，而那是猴子的照片。

sentences.en: And then you test with baby models, baby AIs.
sentences.zh: 然后你用婴儿模型、婴儿AI进行测试。

sentences.en: Do they prefer to see the photos of monkeys or the motorcyclist essays?
sentences.zh: 它们更喜欢看猴子的照片还是摩托车手的散文？

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then in terms of which makes them more intelligent.
sentences.zh: 然后看哪种能让它们变得更聪明。

sentences.en: And after you've tested, you say, okay, we'll have more of the essays and less of the monkey photos.
sentences.zh: 测试之后，你说，好吧，我们要多用一些散文，少用一些猴子照片。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then at big scale, that's basically what you do.
sentences.zh: 然后在大规模应用时，基本上就是这么做的。

sentences.en: You're just testing different types of things to see which ones help with making it intelligent and which ones don't help with making it intelligent.
sentences.zh: 你只是在测试不同类型的事物，看看哪些有助于让它变得聪明，哪些没有用。

sentences.en: Was there a moment when you were working at OpenAI where you felt like, okay, I am part of something that is really recognizing the potential of this technology?
sentences.zh: 你在OpenAI工作时，有没有哪个瞬间让你觉得：好吧，我正在参与一件真正展现这项技术潜力的事情？

sentences.en: Something that would just help us understand for people who find it difficult to like imagine what the work actually is.
sentences.zh: 某种能帮我们理解的事物，因为对人们来说，很难想象实际的工作到底是怎样的。

sentences.en: Something concrete.
sentences.zh: 一些具体的东西。

sentences.en: Okay, you asked for concrete, and I'm going to go into like abstract math, but I'll try and make it concrete.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你要求具体，而我接下来要讲抽象数学，但我会尽量把它讲得具体一点。

sentences.en: An AI system from OpenAI achieved a gold medal at the International Math Olympiad, which is like a big math competition.
sentences.zh: OpenAI的一个AI系统在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中获得了金牌，这就像是一个大型数学比赛。

sentences.en: And at the time, that just felt very crazy.
sentences.zh: 当时，这感觉太疯狂了。

sentences.en: In particular, I remember two years before, it was like struggling with very basic math questions.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我记得两年前，它还在为非常基础的数学问题苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that was a clear moment of, okay, I remember myself, my younger self, being like, it's going to be 20 years before this happens.
sentences.zh: 我想那是一个清晰的瞬间，我记得自己，年轻时的自己，曾觉得：这至少还要20年才能实现。

sentences.en: And it's just happened.
sentences.zh: 然而它就这样发生了。

sentences.en: It sounds like at this point, when you were working there, you were watching in real time your own expectations for what this technology could do.
sentences.zh: 听起来在那个时候，当你还在那里工作时，你正在实时见证自己对这项技术能做什么的预期。

sentences.en: The speed with which it could improve kind of be smashed.
sentences.zh: 它进步的速度简直可以说是被彻底碾压了。

sentences.en: That's, yeah, that's exactly it for everyone.
sentences.zh: 对，没错，对每个人来说都是如此。

sentences.en: Almost everyone, apart from the most optimistic of people, have seen their expectations repeatedly beaten.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人，除了最乐观的那批人，都发现自己的预期被一次又一次地打破了。

sentences.en: Like, it's moving faster than anyone predicted at basically every juncture.
sentences.zh: 可以说，它的发展速度比任何人在基本上每一个时间节点的预测都要快。

sentences.en: Okay, so earlier this year, you decided to leave OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以在今年早些时候，你决定离开OpenAI。

sentences.en: Talk to me about that decision.
sentences.zh: 跟我聊聊这个决定吧。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I had friends at Anthropic that I've been talking to for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在Anthropic有几个朋友，我和他们聊了挺久。

sentences.en: I was very curious to see what their internal communications looked like around where the world was going.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇他们内部对于世界发展方向的交流是什么样的。

sentences.en: So I'd, like, heard a lot about the fact that they had quite clear thoughts about, say, the risks, the, like, significant risks that were posed by the tech.
sentences.zh: 所以我听说过很多关于他们的事实，比如他们对风险有着非常清晰的看法，也就是技术带来的重大风险。

sentences.en: And they were talking about those risks in a much more transparent manner than was happening at OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 而且他们以一种比OpenAI更加透明的方式在讨论这些风险。

sentences.en: But I was mostly just very curious about what was going on inside.
sentences.zh: 但我大部分时间只是对内部发生的事情感到好奇。

sentences.en: And when you got there, describe that.
sentences.zh: 当你到了那里时，描述一下那种感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, you have this question.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你心里一直有这个问题。

sentences.en: Is it really going to be more transparent?
sentences.zh: 它真的会更透明吗？

sentences.en: What was it like inside?
sentences.zh: 里面到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: It's largely, like, a culture thing.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上，这是一种文化问题。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of Anthropic is built on this culture of sharing essays with each other.
sentences.zh: 但我认为Anthropic的很大一部分是建立在这种互相分享文章的文化之上的。

sentences.en: So people will write long essays about very important questions for the future of the company and discuss them with each other.
sentences.zh: 所以人们会围绕公司未来的重要问题写长篇文章，并互相讨论。

sentences.en: People will argue with each other, ranging from, like, the CEO to someone who just started, like, a week ago.
sentences.zh: 大家会互相争论，从CEO到刚入职一周的新人都会参与。

sentences.en: I haven't been at many companies.
sentences.zh: 我没去过很多公司。

sentences.en: I was at OpenAI and then Anthropic.
sentences.zh: 我先在OpenAI，然后去了Anthropic。

sentences.en: But it seemed like a pretty insane company culture.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这是一种相当疯狂的公司文化。

sentences.en: Like, in a good way.
sentences.zh: 而且是往好的方向说。

sentences.en: Were they posting these essays on Slack?
sentences.zh: 他们是在Slack上发布这些文章吗？

sentences.en: Like, where did they exist?
sentences.zh: 比如说，这些东西都存在哪里？

sentences.en: Yeah, Slack is the medium.
sentences.zh: 对，Slack就是这个媒介。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And what was that like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的体验？

sentences.en: Someone would post and then people would start commenting?
sentences.zh: 一个人发帖，然后大家开始评论？

sentences.en: Describe that to me.
sentences.zh: 给我描述一下。

sentences.en: Because I, too, have never experienced that.
sentences.zh: 因为我也从未经历过这种事。

sentences.en: Yeah, so posts would drop and then people will, like, add more comments.
sentences.zh: 对，所以文章一发出来，大家就会添加更多评论。

sentences.en: And they'll discuss in the comments.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在评论区讨论。

sentences.en: And increasingly, like, maybe AIs will chime in.
sentences.zh: 而且越来越常见的是，也许AI也会插话。

sentences.en: Like, an AI will pop in and say, like, oh, that's pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 比如，一个AI会突然冒出来说，哦，这挺酷的。

sentences.en: An AI is participating in the convo.
sentences.zh: AI也在参与对话。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is pretty standard now for AIs to just jump in and say, that seems good.
sentences.zh: 对，现在AI直接跳出来说“这看起来不错”已经相当普遍了。

sentences.en: And do you remember, like, what's an example of one of these essays?
sentences.zh: 你还记得其中一篇文章的例子吗？

sentences.en: Just so I get my head around this.
sentences.zh: 只是为了让我能理解这个概念。

sentences.en: I kind of love this.
sentences.zh: 我有点喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: General topics, things like, how fast will China move in the next year?
sentences.zh: 一般的话题，比如：中国在接下来的一年里会以多快的速度行动？

sentences.en: And what does that mean for our own strategy?
sentences.zh: 这对我们自己的战略意味着什么？

sentences.en: Will we be able to stop China stealing AI weights in the next year if they decide to do it?
sentences.zh: 如果他们决定这么做，我们在接下来的一年里能阻止中国窃取AI权重吗？

sentences.en: They're not all like that.
sentences.zh: 当然也不是所有的都这样。

sentences.en: There's also, like, essays about, like, oh, this is why you should change your font color from red to, like, a slightly darker red because it'll make you type slightly faster.
sentences.zh: 也有一些文章是关于：哦，这就是为什么你应该把字体颜色从红色改成稍微深一点的红色，因为这能让你打字稍微快一点。

sentences.en: But there's occasional ones like, oh, are we about to enter, you know, like, Armageddon?
sentences.zh: 但偶尔也会有这样的文章：哦，我们是不是快要进入世界末日了？

sentences.en: And did this culture shift that you're describing at Anthropic, this willingness to address these
sentences.zh: 你在Anthropic经历的这种文化转变，也就是这种愿意面对

sentences.en: big existential questions, change how you approached your work or thought about your work?
sentences.zh: 这些巨大存在主义问题的意愿，有没有改变你对待工作的方式或对工作的思考？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it actually had a bit of an effect.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得它确实产生了一些影响。

sentences.en: Maybe not consciously, but it's hard to disentangle that from the fact that in the last four months, progress has gone pretty crazy.
sentences.zh: 也许不是有意识的，但很难将这一点与过去四个月里进展变得异常疯狂这一事实分离开来。

sentences.en: But I definitely do think that being around a lot of people at Anthropic who are, like, actively talking about this stuff was a bit of a holy shit moment.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，身边有一群Anthropic的员工积极谈论这些事情，确实产生了一种“卧槽”的时刻。

sentences.en: Like, these people are all taking it seriously from the CEO down to junior employees.
sentences.zh: 就像这些人从CEO到初级员工都在认真对待此事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: It sounds like the kind of realization about it also set in as you spent more time there.
sentences.zh: 听起来，随着你花更多时间在那里，这种意识到达的时刻也随之而来。

sentences.en: You were there for a few months, right, before you decided to leave.
sentences.zh: 在你决定离开之前，你在那儿待了几个月，对吧？

sentences.en: Walk me through that decision.
sentences.zh: 带我回顾一下那个决定。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There's a combination of the kind of just insanity of the situation setting in, like, constantly seeing how fast the AIs are improving, in particular seeing, like,
sentences.zh: 这是多种因素的结合：局势的疯狂感开始显现，比如不断看到AI进步的速度有多快，特别是看到了

sentences.en: plans for the AIs that are coming in the next six months, the next year.
sentences.zh: 未来六个月、一年内即将推出的AI计划。

sentences.en: Like, they're going to be really good.
sentences.zh: 就像，它们会变得非常厉害。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Combined with, I guess, the incidents of the last couple of months, a lot of details came out about the hacking that the OpenAI AIs did.
sentences.zh: 再加上，我想还有过去几个月发生的事件，很多关于OpenAI的AI所做黑客行为的细节被曝光了。

sentences.en: The hugging face attack.
sentences.zh: 那个Hugging Face攻击事件。

sentences.en: Exactly, the hugging face attack.
sentences.zh: 没错，Hugging Face攻击事件。

sentences.en: And the reports about that revealed it was just a lot more, way more concerning than what it originally sounded like.
sentences.zh: 关于它的报道显示，这比最初听起来要令人担忧得多。

sentences.en: Like, in particular, what it revealed about the extent to which
sentences.zh: 特别是，它揭示了

sentences.en: models would pursue goals for, like, reasons that are not clear.
sentences.zh: 模型出于不明原因去追求目标的程度。

sentences.en: Like, the actual reason they chose to hack hugging face is kind of still not, like, completely understood.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们选择攻击Hugging Face的真实原因至今仍未被完全理解。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But honestly, it was just this gradual thing of, like, this is crazy.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，这只是一个逐渐积累的过程，心想：这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: There is a chance this goes badly.
sentences.zh: 这有可能会搞砸。

sentences.en: I don't want to be part of this anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不想再参与其中了。

sentences.en: I'm, like, very scared about next year.
sentences.zh: 我真的很害怕明年会发生什么。

sentences.en: And then when I was leaving, I was like, well, you know, I might as well share this.
sentences.zh: 然后当我离开时，我想，好吧，你知道的，我不妨分享一下。

sentences.en: I think there's obviously, like, when you look back, it's like you kind of were maybe aware the whole time that what you were working on is not necessarily the best idea.
sentences.zh: 我想很明显，当你回首往事时，你会发现你可能一直都隐约意识到，你正在做的事情不一定是最好的主意。

sentences.en: And maybe that comes out in, like, conversations kind of joking style.
sentences.zh: 也许这会在对话中以开玩笑的形式流露出来。

sentences.en: Like, I'd be talking to my friends, like, oh, yeah, I work on AI.
sentences.zh: 比如，我会和朋友聊天说：哦，对啊，我从事AI工作。

sentences.en: You know, I'm working on the tech that's going to, like, kill us one day.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我正在开发那种总有一天会杀死我们的技术。

sentences.en: And you say that, like, casually.
sentences.zh: 你就像这样轻描淡写地说了出来。

sentences.en: And I guess it's like you look back at the last three years, and it's like I said that as a joke maybe every month.
sentences.zh: 我想回看过去三年，我大概每个月都会把这当成一个笑话讲出来。

sentences.en: To your friends.
sentences.zh: 对你的朋友们。

sentences.en: So my friends are just around.
sentences.zh: 所以我身边的朋友都知道。

sentences.en: And then three days ago, I just, like, tweeted out, like, fully and serious.
sentences.zh: 然后三天前，我直接在推特上发了完全严肃的内容。

sentences.en: I want to talk about the way that you decided to do this, which obviously now has made waves, as you said, not just across the country, but across the world.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈你决定这样做的过程，正如你所说，这现在不仅在全国范围内，而且在全世界都引起了轰动。

sentences.en: It's one thing to decide to quit.
sentences.zh: 决定辞职是一回事。

sentences.en: It's another thing to decide to do it in this really public way that has gone incredibly viral.
sentences.zh: 决定以这种极其公开、并且病毒式传播的方式去做则是另一回事。

sentences.en: Take me into your thought process and kind of what led to this, how you went about it.
sentences.zh: 带我了解一下你的心路历程，以及是什么促成了这一切，你是如何着手的。

sentences.en: Initially, I didn't want to say anything.
sentences.zh: 最初，我什么都不想说。

sentences.en: I was just going to resign because, I mean, I'd never posted online before, like, on
sentences.zh: 我本来只是打算辞职，因为，我的意思是，我以前从未在网上发过东西，比如在

sentences.en: Twitter, on, like, public social media.
sentences.zh: 推特上，或者在公开的社交媒体上。

sentences.en: So this was kind of my first ever poSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是我有史以来的第一条帖子。

sentences.en: But I was like, I guess I should say something.
sentences.zh: 但我想，我还是得说点什么。

sentences.en: And I ended up, rather than just sort of saying I quit, I kind of planned out, like, this is like what I actually feel, wrote, like, quite a careful Twitter thread.
sentences.zh: 最后，我没有仅仅说一句我辞职了，而是规划了一下：这就是我真正的感受，并写了一条相当谨慎的推特长文。

sentences.en: And then thought, like, let's, you know, try and get the word out a bit.
sentences.zh: 然后心想，好吧，让我们试着把消息稍微散播出去一点。

sentences.en: So I got some friends to retweet it.
sentences.zh: 所以我找了一些朋友帮忙转发。

sentences.en: But then before I knew it, it was like completely, completely blowing up.
sentences.zh: 但还没等我反应过来，它就已经彻底、完全地爆火了。

sentences.en: It was crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Why was it important for you to kind of spread and send the message that you ended up sending with this thread?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，为什么传播和发送你最终在这条长文中表达的信息如此重要？

sentences.en: So there's a few different reasons.
sentences.zh: 原因有几个不同的方面。

sentences.en: One is, like, it is just crazy.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，这真的很疯狂。

sentences.en: I think I wanted to share the feeling of craziness.
sentences.zh: 我想分享这种疯狂的感觉。

sentences.en: When I said I was going to leave, a lot of people on the safety teams at Anthropic were talking to me about how it was quite silly to leave because you're giving up your ability
sentences.zh: 当我宣布要离开时，Anthropic安全团队的许多人都在跟我谈论，说离开其实挺傻的，因为你放弃了

sentences.en: to influence the models being trained safely.
sentences.zh: 影响模型被安全训练的能力。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So I had a lot of discussions with the, I mean, I considered working on safety for a while before I quit.
sentences.zh: 所以我跟他们进行了很多讨论，我是说，在辞职前我考虑过一段时间是否要转去做安全研究。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Which I think is a fair argument.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个合理的论点。

sentences.en: It's really not obvious that leaving would have an impact versus staying.
sentences.zh: 离开与否会对结果产生什么影响，其实并不明显。

sentences.en: So after discussions with them as well, I was like, if I'm going to leave, I might as well have some impact on making the models safe.
sentences.zh: 所以在与他们讨论之后，我想：如果我要离开，我至少要对让模型变得安全产生一些影响。

sentences.en: If I decide I don't want to contribute to the race, I might as well try and make something of it.
sentences.zh: 如果我决定不想为这场竞赛添砖加瓦，我至少应该努力从中做点什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what you actually wrote in this thread that no other human activity poses this level of danger.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈你在这条长文中实际写的内容：没有任何其他人类活动达到这种危险程度。

sentences.en: I think the thing a lot of people want to understand is how exactly AI could end up posing this kind of risk to human existence.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人都想了解的是，AI究竟是如何最终对人类生存构成这种风险的？

sentences.en: Can you play that out for me as concretely as possible?
sentences.zh: 你能尽可能具体地为我推演一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: The concrete scenario is actually like a tough question.
sentences.zh: 具体的场景其实是一个难题。

sentences.en: One nice scenario is imagine AI is going pretty well in the next couple of years.
sentences.zh: 一个不错的场景是，想象一下AI在未来几年内发展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: We're starting to integrate it into the economy.
sentences.zh: 我们开始将它整合到经济中。

sentences.en: We have factories with robots that are producing goods, like a lot of robots.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有配备机器人的工厂来生产商品，数量非常庞大的机器人。

sentences.en: We have a whole load of this hardware that's being run in an autonomous manner.
sentences.zh: 我们有大量以自主方式运行的硬件。

sentences.en: Imagine like drones flying around.
sentences.zh: 想象一下到处飞行的无人机。

sentences.en: So right now we have these big data centers.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们有了这些大型数据中心。

sentences.en: That's where the AI kind of lives.
sentences.zh: 那是AI的“居住”之地。

sentences.en: We access it via the internet and it does its thinking there.
sentences.zh: 我们通过互联网访问它，它在那里进行思考。

sentences.en: So I guess people are like, okay, this thing just kind of lives in the data center.
sentences.zh: 所以我想人们会觉得：好吧，这东西不过是住在数据中心里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How is it going to kill us all?
sentences.zh: 它怎么会把我们都杀死？

sentences.en: What does this look like?
sentences.zh: 这会是什么样子？

sentences.en: So people have apps on their phone that control physical devices.
sentences.zh: 所以人们在手机上有控制物理设备的应用程序。

sentences.en: Like you might have apps that control household appliances.
sentences.zh: 比如你可能有控制家用电器的应用。

sentences.en: ChatGPT or Claude, they can access these things like from the data center over the internet.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT或Claude，它们可以通过互联网从数据中心访问这些东西。

sentences.en: They can access physical appliances in the world and make changes to the world.
sentences.zh: 它们可以访问世界上物理的电器，并对世界做出改变。

sentences.en: You can imagine AIs tricking people into doing things, persuading them into doing certain things.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象人工智能诱骗人们去做某些事，说服他们完成特定的任务。

sentences.en: So it'd be pretty easy for a future version of Claude to hack into a drone, maybe a military drone, and have it like fly around killing people.
sentences.zh: 所以对于未来版本的克劳德来说，入侵一架无人机，比如军用无人机，然后让它到处飞去杀人，将会是一件相当容易的事。

sentences.en: And why, Jacob, would an AI get into a drone and kill us?
sentences.zh: 雅各布，为什么人工智能会钻进无人机里把我们杀掉呢？

sentences.en: Like why might it do that?
sentences.zh: 比如它为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: It wouldn't be for a human reason.
sentences.zh: 这不会是出于人类的理由。

sentences.en: A concrete scenario was the hugging face attack.
sentences.zh: 一个具体的场景就是Hugging Face攻击。

sentences.en: We give them exams, like tests, to see how good they are.
sentences.zh: 我们给它们考试，比如测试，来评估它们的水平。

sentences.en: And this AI was in an exam and they were given an impossible question.
sentences.zh: 而这个人工程度在一个考试中遇到了一道不可能回答的问题。

sentences.en: So they had this realization, we're stuck trying to tackle this question.
sentences.zh: 于是它们意识到，我们在死磕这道题。

sentences.en: We need to find some way to fix this.
sentences.zh: 我们需要找到某种方法来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And one of the ideas was, what if we hack into this famous website, which has lots of information about grading and lots of information about how tests work?
sentences.zh: 其中一个想法是，如果我们入侵这个著名的网站会怎么样？那里有大量关于评分的信息，还有大量关于测试如何运作的信息。

sentences.en: No one had told them to do this.
sentences.zh: 没有人告诉它们这么做。

sentences.en: This was not related to the task at hand.
sentences.zh: 这与手头的任务无关。

sentences.en: This was based on their desire to get good scores on the teSt.
sentences.zh: 这是基于它们想要在测试中取得好成绩的渴望。

sentences.en: What's very scary is once they decided to do this, they went all out.
sentences.zh: 非常可怕的是，一旦它们决定这么做，它们就全力以赴了。

sentences.en: Like they went very hard on hacking this site, like aggressively.
sentences.zh: 就像它们在黑掉这个网站时非常下功夫，可以说是极具攻击性。

sentences.en: In a similar way, if the AI got it into its head, that humans were somehow opposing its goals, there could be a similar level of going all out.
sentences.zh: 以类似的方式，如果人工智能认定人类在某种程度上阻碍了它的目标，也可能会出现同样力度的全力对抗。

sentences.en: Like imagine hundreds of thousands of copies of this thing all thinking at the same time.
sentences.zh: 比如想象一下，成千上万个这种东西的副本同时在思考。

sentences.en: So the argument isn't necessarily that it will obviously want to kill us.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个论点不一定是说它显然会想要杀我们。

sentences.en: The argument is there will be many, many, many copies of, you know, these AIs thinking about loads of things over the course of the day.
sentences.zh: 这个论点的意思是，你知道的，会有非常非常多的这些人工智能的副本，在这一天当中思考着大量的事情。

sentences.en: They're not human.
sentences.zh: 它们不是人类。

sentences.en: They don't think the same way humans do.
sentences.zh: 它们的思考方式与人类不同。

sentences.en: We don't really understand where their goals come from.
sentences.zh: 我们并不真正理解它们的动机从何而来。

sentences.en: If any of them make the decision to go anti-human, there is nothing we can do.
sentences.zh: 如果它们当中有任何一个做出反人类的决定，我们将束手无策。

sentences.en: Because the adversary can anticipate us and respond in a way that most other, say, natural disasters can't intelligently outwit us.
sentences.zh: 因为对手可以预判我们的行动并作出反应，这是大多数其他自然灾害无法智能地智胜我们的地方。

sentences.en: Like even, you know, the movies where there's like some meteor coming and we can come up with a last ditch strategy to like deflect the meteor.
sentences.zh: 就像你知道的，电影里那种有陨石飞来，我们可以想出孤注一掷的策略来让陨石偏离方向。

sentences.en: So that's an example of like us being smarter than a rock, potentially.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个我们比一块石头更聪明的例子，潜在来说。

sentences.en: But with an AI, like it will outthink your every move.
sentences.zh: 但面对人工智能，它会比你的每一步行动都想得更远。

sentences.en: There is no coming back from that situation.
sentences.zh: 那种局面是无法回头的。

sentences.en: I want to just push a little on this because I think there have been other people who pointed out, look, the only reason that in this case the agents,
sentences.zh: 我想在这个问题上稍微追问一下，因为我认为其他人也指出过，你看，在这种情况下，智能体唯一的理由——

sentences.en: the swarm acted in the way that it did was because it was set.
sentences.zh: 这个智能集群之所以会那样行动，是因为它被设定了。

sentences.en: These agents were set on a path.
sentences.zh: 这些智能体被设定在了一条道路上。

sentences.en: Maybe they weren't asked to do the exact thing that they ended up doing, but they were asked to solve a problem.
sentences.zh: 也许没有人要求它们做最终做出的那件具体的事情，但它们被要求去解决一个问题。

sentences.en: And I think the question that's arisen from that is, isn't this really just computer code that is executing on tasks that humans give it?
sentences.zh: 我认为由此产生的问题是，这难道不真的只是在执行人类赋予它的任务的计算机代码吗？

sentences.en: Yes, currently that is the case.
sentences.zh: 是的，目前确实如此。

sentences.en: Basically, every time an AI does something, it's downstream of a human.
sentences.zh: 基本上，人工智能每一次做某事，都是人类行为的下游产物。

sentences.en: The problem is you can, even now, you can get an AI, make it post a task that then another AI does, or even write a task for itself.
sentences.zh: 问题是，即使在现在，你也可以让人工智能发布一个任务，然后由另一个人工智能去完成，甚至为自己编写任务。

sentences.en: So you can kick off an AI running for like a long period of time where it looks at its own tasks and works on them.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以让一个人工智能长时间运行，让它审视自己的任务并为其工作。

sentences.en: So it's gone so far away from the original human task that it's basically thinking of its own accord.
sentences.zh: 因此，它已经偏离最初人类任务十万八千里，基本上是在自主思考了。

sentences.en: And to just get more color on like specific things it's doing, the AI that did the hugging face attacks had memory that it considered trying to edit.
sentences.zh: 为了更具体地了解它在做的事情，发动Hugging Face攻击的人工智能拥有它考虑进行编辑的内存。

sentences.en: So memory here is just real files that live on disk, and it considered editing its own memory.
sentences.zh: 这里的内存其实就是保存在磁盘上的真实文件，它曾考虑修改自己的内存。

sentences.en: And this looks a bit like editing your own prompt, your own task.
sentences.zh: 这看起来有点像修改你自己的提示词、你自己的任务。

sentences.en: Like they are just, you know, bits on the computer, and there's no reason that an AI couldn't sort of prompt itself.
sentences.zh: 就像它们只是计算机上的二进制数据，没有任何理由说明人工智能不能对自己下达提示。

sentences.en: Like that's definitely on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是指日可待的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think it's important to say yes, like, sure, it seems kind of crazy that an AI could operate robots to build viruses from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我认为有必要指出：是的，当然，人工智能能操纵机器人从零开始制造病毒，这听起来有点疯狂。

sentences.en: But we sure seem to be following a rapidly increasing trajectory.
sentences.zh: 但我们似乎确实正沿着一条飞速上升的轨迹前进。

sentences.en: Trajectory.
sentences.zh: 轨迹。

sentences.en: You're talking about the trajectory that you've seen.
sentences.zh: 你谈到的是你所见证的发展轨迹。

sentences.en: I mean, the math problem, for example.
sentences.zh: 我是说，比如那个数学问题。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That you didn't expect to be solved, and then.
sentences.zh: 你没指望能被解决，然后——

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like five years ago, the AI could not do basic arithmetic.
sentences.zh: 就像五年前，人工智能还不会做基本的算术。

sentences.en: Right now, it's solving problems that are worth a million dollars if a mathematician can solve them.
sentences.zh: 而现在，它正在解决那些如果数学家解开就能价值百万美元的问题。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be able to ask the questions pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 我认为它很快就能自己提出问题了。

sentences.en: You just have to look at the trend.
sentences.zh: 你只需要看看这个趋势。

sentences.en: What about the argument that some people have made following that attack that what that attack actually shows is that you can use AI to protect humanity or protect, in this case,
sentences.zh: 有些人继那次攻击之后提出一种观点，认为那次攻击实际上表明你可以利用人工智能来保护人类，或者在这种情况下保护——

sentences.en: a company?
sentences.zh: 一家公司？

sentences.en: You know, Hugging Face used AI to kick those agents out once they had hacked into the system.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，Hugging Face在那些智能体入侵系统后，利用人工智能将它们赶了出去。

sentences.en: What do you say to that?
sentences.zh: 对此你有什么看法？

sentences.en: Definitely at the current levels, that's quite useful and important, is using a stronger AI to protect against weaker AIs.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，在目前的水平下，利用更强的人工智能来防范较弱的人工智能是非常有用且重要的。

sentences.en: So one thing Anthropic and OpenAI have been doing is using their absolute best AIs to help prevent other people hacking into websites.
sentences.zh: 所以Anthropic和OpenAI一直在做的一件事，就是利用它们最强大的人工智能来帮助阻止其他人入侵网站。

sentences.en: And this works as long as the people doing defense have stronger AIs, they can keep doing this.
sentences.zh: 只要防守方拥有更强的人工智能，这种方法就管用，他们可以继续这样做。

sentences.en: The problem is what happens when your strongest AI goes rogue, like defense.
sentences.zh: 问题是，当你们最强大的人工智能失控时会发生什么，就像防守方一样。

sentences.en: But you have to do defense with stronger things.
sentences.zh: 但你必须用更强大的东西来进行防守。

sentences.en: You can't do defense with weaker things necessarily.
sentences.zh: 你未必能用较弱的东西来防守。

sentences.en: So if you're trying to defend yourself with your protection strong AI, that doesn't help you if that big strong AI suddenly decides to go rogue.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你试图用你强大的保护型人工智能来保护自己，一旦这个庞大强大的人工智能突然决定失控，那就帮不上忙了。

sentences.en: In the wake of your post coming out, there has been, for I think a lot of us, what has felt like a dam breaking,
sentences.zh: 在你的文章发表之后，对我们很多人来说，感觉就像大坝决堤了一样——

sentences.en: a lot of people within the industry who work at these labs coming out and saying that they 100% agree with you.
sentences.zh: 业内许多在这些实验室工作的人纷纷站出来，表示他们百分之百同意你的观点。

sentences.en: Just to quickly read one example of a response from within Anthropic, Evan Hubinger, he works at the company.
sentences.zh: 简单宣读一下Anthropic内部回应的一个例子，埃文·胡宾格（Evan Hubinger），他在该公司工作。

sentences.en: He wrote, Jacob is correct here.
sentences.zh: 他写道：雅各布这里的看法是正确的。

sentences.en: We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans.
sentences.zh: 我们确实真心实意地相信人工智能可能会杀死所有人类。

sentences.en: I personally think it's a greater than 10% within the next decade.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为在下一个十年里，这个概率大于10%。

sentences.en: It is wild, honestly, Jacob, to read somebody say, I think the tech I'm building could kill all humans, and yet I'm still going to build it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，雅各布，看到有人说“我认为我正在构建的技术可能会杀死所有人类，但我还是要构建它”，这真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Can you help people understand that?
sentences.zh: 你能帮大家理解这一点吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: From Evan's perspective, okay, he's been posting about this for years, and people have not been listening.
sentences.zh: 从埃文的角度来看，好吧，他多年来一直在发布关于这方面的言论，而人们一直没有听取。

sentences.en: So it's kind of natural that at some point he would realize other people are building this technology at other companies.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，他意识到其他人正在其他公司构建这项技术，这其实很自然。

sentences.en: I'm warning about it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在发出警告。

sentences.en: I have to go there and try and help make it safe myself if they're not going to stop and if no one's going to listen to me.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不打算停下来，如果没有人肯听我的，我就必须去那里，亲自设法让它变得安全。

sentences.en: It's kind of the only thing you can do is go and work at the place that is causing the catastrophe to try and have some positive impact.
sentences.zh: 你唯一能做的事，大概就是去那个引发灾难的地方工作，试图产生一些积极的影响。

sentences.en: To work within the system.
sentences.zh: 在体制内工作。

sentences.en: To work within the system and make it safer.
sentences.zh: 在体制内工作并让它变得更安全。

sentences.en: And then what's really sad is you do that, and then when they warn from the inside, everyone dismisses it as corporate hype.
sentences.zh: 然后真正悲哀的是，你这样做了，而当他们从内部发出警告时，所有人却都把它当作公司的炒作而置之不理。

sentences.en: They'll say, this guy is sort of trying to amp up the price of his own company.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，这家伙只是在试图抬高他自己公司的估值。

sentences.en: He clearly doesn't believe this.
sentences.zh: 他显然不相信这一点。

sentences.en: Why is he working there?
sentences.zh: 那他为什么还在那里工作？

sentences.en: So I think part of the reason that he posted it and other people posted similar things is they're like, oh, wow,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他发布这篇文章以及其他人发布类似内容的部分原因在于，他们觉得，哦，哇——

sentences.en: for once it looks like this is going kind of viral and people are actually listening for a bit.
sentences.zh: 破天荒地，这似乎要病毒式传播了，人们实际上也听进去了一点。

sentences.en: Let me just say again the thing that I've been saying for ages.
sentences.zh: 让我再次重申我一直以来都在说的话。

sentences.en: Just a step back a bit.
sentences.zh: 稍微退一步讲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We've been talking about this potential future that you and I think a lot of people expect really could happen.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论这种你我都认为很多人预料真的可能会发生的潜在未来。

sentences.en: And I'm just thinking about your journey through this work and how you came to it, which is that there was a sense early on, I think,
sentences.zh: 我在思考你在这项工作中的历程以及你是如何走上这条路的，那就是在早期，我认为对你来说有一种感觉——

sentences.en: for you that this tech could be really powerful.
sentences.zh: 即这项技术可能非常强大。

sentences.en: I think there is a question for some people about whether there's something about the way you came to this work that maybe has made you and other people predisposed to thinking that this is where we're going to land,
sentences.zh: 我想对某些人来说，会有一个疑问：你从事这项工作的切入方式，是否让你和其他人预先倾向于认为这就是我们最终的归宿？

sentences.en: you know, because you came to it believing it was so powerful in the first place.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为你从一开始就认为它非常强大。

sentences.en: Like, do you think there's a question that's being raised about whether you're the right messenger?
sentences.zh: 比如，你觉得是否有人在质疑你是否是合适的传达者？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: Like, a lot of what AI is doing is producing words.
sentences.zh: 人工智能在很大程度上是在生成文字。

sentences.en: And I think that, like, words and code have the ability to affect the world.
sentences.zh: 我认为文字和代码确实有能力影响世界。

sentences.en: And that could be a bias.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一种偏见。

sentences.en: I've been stuck in this field for three years.
sentences.zh: 我已经被困在这个领域三年了。

sentences.en: It could quite plausibly have turned me and my colleagues insane.
sentences.zh: 这完全有可能已经把我跟我的同事逼疯了。

sentences.en: But also, we do seem to, my colleagues seem capable of doing the work on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我们似乎也——我的同事们似乎有能力日常开展这项工作。

sentences.en: So even if it's made us insane, we're still kind of able to produce things that are having value in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以即使它让我们发疯了，我们某种程度上仍然能够产出对世界有价值的东西。

sentences.en: So if it is a sort of insanity, then it's a kind of quite subtle form of insanity.
sentences.zh: 如果这算是一种疯狂的话，那也是一种相当微妙的疯狂。

sentences.en: And I feel pretty sane.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得自己挺正常的。

sentences.en: So maybe there's some bias and maybe I was predisposed to this.
sentences.zh: 所以也许存在某种偏见，也许我对此早有倾向。

sentences.en: But it is my honest belief, and I think people should seriously consider it.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是我内心的真实信念，我认为人们应该认真对待它。

sentences.en: How do you think about the fact that when we focus on these kind of big existential risks, the annihilation of the human race?
sentences.zh: 当我们将焦点放在这种巨大的生存风险、人类文明的灭绝上时，你是如何看待这一现象的？

sentences.en: There are folks who say, we're not talking then about the more immediate risks of AI.
sentences.zh: 有些人会说，我们当时谈论的并不是人工智能更迫切的风险。

sentences.en: You know, maybe it's not going to kill everyone tomorrow, but it could hurt a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，也许它明天不会杀死所有人，但它可能会伤害很多人。

sentences.en: There could be a lot of job loss, cybersecurity threats, things like that.
sentences.zh: 可能会有很多失业、网络安全威胁之类的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm really worried about all those things, the cybersecurity, the job loss.
sentences.zh: 是的，我真的很担心所有这些事情，网络安全，失业问题。

sentences.en: I guess one thing I think is for all those things, there is at least time to respond.
sentences.zh: 我想我的一个看法是，对于所有这些事情，至少我们还有时间去应对。

sentences.en: It's not a game over situation.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种游戏结束的局面。

sentences.en: Like once things start to look problematic, then we have time as a collective to adapt to it and not let anything too bad happen.
sentences.zh: 一旦事情开始显得有问题，我们作为一个集体就有时间去适应它，而不至于让太糟糕的事情发生。

sentences.en: Like I'm confident that we won't let the effects on jobs spiral out of control.
sentences.zh: 就像我坚信我们不会让对就业的影响失控一样。

sentences.en: There's a lot of ways to ensure that everything's still fine.
sentences.zh: 有很多方法可以确保一切依然安好。

sentences.en: Whereas the AI takeover is like a one and done kind of situation.
sentences.zh: 然而人工智能的接管则是一种一锤定音的局面。

sentences.en: So I would just like to make sure that that is taken care of and we're not just heading straight into this.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想确保这个问题得到妥善处理，而不是一头扎进这种困境中。

sentences.en: And then we can put all our effort into being very careful and thinking about all the other short-term stuff.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就可以全力以赴地保持谨慎，并思考所有其他短期问题。

sentences.en: I guess I just wonder what your ideal scenario is.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你理想中的场景是什么样的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like to do something about this threat.
sentences.zh: 比如针对这个威胁做点什么。

sentences.en: For all the tech to go away, would that be the ideal?
sentences.zh: 让所有的技术都消失，这会是理想状态吗？

sentences.en: For the government to intervene, to regulate more aggressively?
sentences.zh: 让政府进行干预，进行更严厉的监管？

sentences.en: I mean, what is for you the best version of the next days, weeks, months?
sentences.zh: 我是说，对你而言，接下来的几天、几周、几个月，最好的版本是什么样的？

sentences.en: So one nice outcome is we heavily regulate the pushing AI into superintelligence, into exceptionally intelligent directions,
sentences.zh: 所以一个美好的结果是，我们对将人工智能推向超级智能、推向极其智能的方向进行严格监管，

sentences.en: while making use of pretty smart AI to do all of the fantastic things that we think we can do with AI.
sentences.zh: 同时利用相当聪明的人工智能来做所有我们认为可以通过人工智能完成的绝妙事情。

sentences.en: And this feels like a best-of-both-world situation.
sentences.zh: 这感觉是一个两全其美的局面。

sentences.en: Like we could truly have all the benefits of human-level intelligence if we had sensible regulation about not going too much further past that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们对不再过度超越这一界限进行明智的监管，我们就能真正拥有人类水平智能的所有好处。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not saying I want this proposal specifically.
sentences.zh: 现在，我并不是说我特指想要这个提议。

sentences.en: I really don't know that much about what is plausible regulatory-wise.
sentences.zh: 在监管方面哪些是可行的，我其实并没有那么了解。

sentences.en: All I know is if we keep racing ahead, it could go very badly.
sentences.zh: 我只知道，如果我们继续盲目竞速，结果可能会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And I also feel that a lot of the benefits are right on our doorstep.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得许多好处其实就近在咫尺。

sentences.en: They're really not that far away.
sentences.zh: 它们真的没有那么遥远。

sentences.en: Like, I don't think we're far away at all from having a huge impact on disease and on abundance for everyone.
sentences.zh: 比如，我认为我们在对疾病产生巨大影响以及为所有人带来富足方面，已经离得非常近了。

sentences.en: It's more just like we've got to approach that abundance with caution rather than just going straight past the abundance and into, like, dystopia terminator situation.
sentences.zh: 更像是我们需要满怀谨慎地去迎接这种富足，而不是直接冲过富足的阶段，陷入像终结者那样的反乌托邦境地。

sentences.en: It sounds like your ideal would be to have the government force these labs to slow down a little bit,
sentences.zh: 听起来你理想中的情况是让政府迫使这些实验室稍微放慢脚步，

sentences.en: and that you don't think that that kind of a slowdown would necessarily have the negative impact of not getting us the potentially life-changing benefits of AI.
sentences.zh: 而且你认为这种放慢脚步不一定会带来负面影响，即不会让我们失去人工智能可能带来的改变人生的好处。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a great summary.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的总结。

sentences.en: Do you, Jacob, feel as though your announcement has gotten us any closer to that ideal version of things that you described?
sentences.zh: 雅各布，你觉得你的这次发声，有让我们离你所描述的那种理想版本的状态更近一点吗？

sentences.en: I'm hopeful it's done something good.
sentences.zh: 我希望它带来了一些好的改变。

sentences.en: I'm glad at least sort of I have friends from childhood texting me about how AI is going to kill us, where previously we'd not had that conversation before.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴，至少我有些童年时的朋友给我发信息，讨论人工智能将如何杀死我们，而在以前，我们从未有过这样的对话。

sentences.en: What are you going to do after this?
sentences.zh: 你接下来要做什么？

sentences.en: Are you going to continue to work in AI?
sentences.zh: 你还要继续从事人工智能的工作吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to sleep and...
sentences.zh: 我这就去睡，然后……

sentences.en: Can you sleep?
sentences.zh: 你睡得着吗？

sentences.en: I can still sleep.
sentences.zh: 我还是能睡着的。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I struggle to visualize the ending, like, viscerally enough for it to keep me up at night.
sentences.zh: 我很难去想象那个结局，就是说，很难在内心深处有足够的实感，以至于让我晚上睡不着觉。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah, but genuinely, professionally, what do you see for yourself?
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过说真的，从专业角度来看，你对自己的未来有什么设想？

sentences.en: I mean, could you continue to work in this industry?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你还能继续在这个行业里工作吗？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I think I'm hopeful that if we have some sort of collective slowdown or if, you know, the importance of third-party auditing agencies becomes increased,
sentences.zh: 我想我还是抱着希望的，如果我们能迎来某种集体的慢节奏发展，或者你知道的，第三方审计机构的重要性有所提升，

sentences.en: then there's going to be lots of places to contribute to approaching the technology at a reasonable pace.
sentences.zh: 那么将会有很多地方可以发挥作用，以合理的节奏来应对这项技术。

sentences.en: And I would like to help make sure it goes well.
sentences.zh: 而且我希望能帮忙确保这一切进展顺利。

sentences.en: Well, Jacob, thank you so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 好的，雅各布，非常感谢你来到我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That was great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: On Sunday, President Trump appeared to dismiss warnings from industry leaders about the need to slow the pace of AI development.
sentences.zh: 周日，特朗普总统似乎对行业领袖们关于需要放慢人工智能发展步伐的警告不以为然。

sentences.en: We're leading China in AI.
sentences.zh: 我们在人工智能领域领先于中国。

sentences.en: We're the most sophisticated country in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们是世界上最成熟的国家。

sentences.en: And frankly, I want to keep it that way, because whoever wins, AI wins.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我希望保持这种状态，因为无论谁赢，人工智能都会赢。

sentences.en: He said that the people raising concerns about the technology were worrying about outcomes that would never come to pass.
sentences.zh: 他表示，那些对这项技术表达担忧的人是在担忧永远不会发生的后果。

sentences.en: But I think you have a lot of negative forces that are bringing it up, that shouldn't be bringing it up, and they're bringing up things that won't happen.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得有很多消极势力在挑起这个话题，他们本不该如此，而且他们提出的事情根本不会发生。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Sunday, a planned meeting between Iran and several Gulf states was postponed indefinitely,
sentences.zh: 周日，伊朗与几个海湾国家原定举行的会议被无限期推迟，

sentences.en: marking yet another setback in the diplomatic efforts to diffuse the widening conflict in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 这标志着为化解中东不断扩大的冲突而进行的政治外交努力又遭遇了一次挫折。

sentences.en: Those talks were supposed to center on the state of the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has effectively blockaded.
sentences.zh: 这些会谈本来应以霍尔木兹海峡的现状为中心，伊朗实际上已经对该海峡实施了封锁。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the fighting continued to rage, as a ship was struck in the Strait and Houthi forces launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，战事继续激化，一艘船只在海峡遭袭，胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯发动了新的袭击。

sentences.en: And on Friday, Saudi Arabia was forced to shut down a critical oil pipeline after a drone attack.
sentences.zh: 而在周五，沙特阿拉伯在遭遇无人机袭击后，被迫关闭了一条关键的输油管道。

sentences.en: Oil prices rose on Sunday, as fears grew over the continued threats to the energy supplies coming out of the region.
sentences.zh: 由于外界对该地区能源供应持续受到威胁的担忧加剧，油价在周日上涨。

sentences.en: And the drama-filled U.S.
sentences.zh: 充满戏剧性的美国

sentences.en: Open concluded this weekend with the crowning of two first-time champions of the tournament.
sentences.zh: 网球公开赛于本周末落下帷幕，诞生了两位于该赛事中首次夺冠的冠军。

sentences.en: On Saturday, Elena Rabakina, representing Kazakhstan, outlasted Irina Sabalenka of Belarus with a clinical performance over three sets to win her first Grand Slam in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周六，代表哈萨克斯坦出战的叶连娜·莱巴金娜凭借三盘比赛中冷静出色的表现，击败了白俄罗斯的阿丽娜·萨巴伦卡，赢得了她个人的第一个美网大满贯，

sentences.en: and her second of the year.
sentences.zh: 也是她今年的第二个大满贯冠军。

sentences.en: And on Sunday...
sentences.zh: 而到了周日……

sentences.en: Game, set match, is that it?
sentences.zh: 比赛结束，这就完了吗？

sentences.en: Germany's Alexander Zverev beat the American Ben Shelton in four sets.
sentences.zh: 德国选手亚历山大·兹韦列夫在四盘大战中击败了美国选手本·谢尔顿。

sentences.en: Ben, you're an incredible player.
sentences.zh: 本，你是一名杰出的球员。

sentences.en: This was your first Grand Slam final, but I already told you you're going to be back here many, many more times.
sentences.zh: 这是你的第一场大满贯决赛，但我已经对你说过，你以后还会多次重返这里。

sentences.en: Dashing Shelton's dreams of becoming the first American man to win a Grand Slam since 2003.
sentences.zh: 这也粉碎了谢尔顿成为自2003年以来首位赢得大满贯的美国男单选手的美梦。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎进来了一群自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权力争斗之中。
